input.message:
Step 3.3 done — discount label shipped clean; one real gap found in the was/now mechanism that needs your call before anyone treats pass criterion 1 as fully proven.

## The one thing that needs your decision

**Consequence:** after this build ships, a real cart line item can never show a struck "Was $X" price next to "Now $Y" — not because anything in this build is missing, but because base SFCC's own cart-pricing code has never been able to do it, for any Zimmermann storefront, today or after SFCC-11 merges.

**Mechanism:** `overrides/app/components/item-variant/item-price.tsx` has two branches. For a real basket line item (`variant.itemId` set — that's every actual cart row), it builds `priceData` with `listPrice: null` hardcoded, and never passes a `quantity` prop to `DisplayPrice` at all. I diffed this file byte-for-byte against `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/item-variant/item-price.jsx` — identical, including the comment ("we don't want to show strikethrough price for cart since listPrice is not available via basket pricing"). This is unmodified base SFCC behaviour, not a bug any prior Zimmermann commit introduced, and not something step 3.3's own "Changes" text asked me to touch (it only names the discount label as new). The *other* branch (no `itemId` — the existing "for wishlist page" path this same shared component already serves) does carry a real `listPrice` and does pass `quantity`, so the mechanism genuinely works — just not through the code path any real cart row takes.

**What I did about it, and what I didn't:** I did not modify `item-price.tsx` — that would have been me silently deciding a pricing-data question (should a cart line ever get a comparable list price, which likely means fetching product pricebook data per line — a materially bigger change than "purely presentational") without your sign-off. Instead I proved pass criterion 1 exactly as worded ("with isOnSale and a listPrice, the struck Was and the Now both render, and both scale with quantity") via the *other*, already-real branch of this same shared component, with the limitation spelled out in-line at the test (`item-variant/index.test.tsx`, new describe block) so nothing reads as more proven than it is. I also chose not to add a Storybook "OnSale" story for `ProductItem` itself, because doing that would mean constructing a mock cart line that secretly isn't itemId-shaped to fake the visual — that's exactly the kind of judgment call your brief told me to surface rather than bury in a comment, so I'm surfacing it instead of shipping it. Your call: leave this as a disclosed gap (consistent with CAI-013's "price-book sourced" framing — this may simply be waiting on real backend/promotions work), or open a follow-up to wire real list-price data into basket-sourced lines now.

## What I changed

- **`overrides/app/components/product-item/index.tsx`** — added `discountLabel?: string` prop (JSDoc explains it's purely presentational, no computation, PROVISIONAL styling pending designer sign-off) and its render slot: `<Text textStyle="caption" color="var(--zimm-color-text-secondary)" data-testid="zimm-discount-label">`, positioned directly after the stepper/price `Flex` row and *before* the existing `message` slot from the prior commit — DOM order is now stepper → discountLabel → message → secondaryActions. No Figma citation exists for this element's own typography (I searched `.claude/session-notes.md` for "discount" myself — it only appears describing the copy, never a type spec), so I matched the nearest sibling caption in the same card (`item-variant.css.ts`'s `colourSize` part — same `textStyle`/colour), flagged PROVISIONAL the same way `zimmQuantityStepper.css.ts:35-38` and `zimmButton.css.ts:244` already do. No new recipe part added — `textStyle` + `var(--zimm-*)` fully cover it per the styling hierarchy, so `product-item.css.ts` is untouched. Also extended the file's top docblock with a step-3.3 paragraph, written in present/past tense only (no future-step claimed as done).
- **`overrides/app/components/product-item/index.stories.tsx`** — added `WithDiscountLabel` story (combined with a warning `message` to prove both slots coexist in order, not just individually).
- **`overrides/app/components/product-item/index.test.tsx`** — added two tests: `discountLabel` omitted → no node (`queryByTestId` absent); `discountLabel` present → exact copy renders, DOM order proven via `compareDocumentPosition` (stepper → discountLabel → message).
- **`overrides/app/components/item-variant/index.test.tsx`** — added a `getPriceData` mock (smallest surface, `...actual`-spread so the existing `getDisplayVariationValues` coverage is untouched) and a new describe block proving the was/now mechanism at quantity 2 *and* quantity 1 (to actually show scaling, not just correctness at one value) via item-price.tsx's non-basket branch — with the limitation above documented at the point of use.
- **Untouched, deliberately:** `item-variant/item-price.tsx` (see above), `product-item/product-item.css.ts` (no recipe change needed), `theme/components/index.ts` (no new recipe to register). No file created under `overrides/app/components/display-price/` — confirmed by `git status` (the directory doesn't exist).

## Pass criteria — evidence

1. *Was/Now render and scale with quantity* — proven in `item-variant/index.test.tsx`'s new describe block, at quantity 2 ($320.00/$400.00) and quantity 1 ($160.00/$200.00), via the mechanism's only currently-real path — see the gap above for the one thing not fully proven.
2. *discountLabel renders beneath the stepper; absent when omitted* — proven in `product-item/index.test.tsx`'s two new tests (DOM-order assertion + absence assertion) and the `WithDiscountLabel` story.
3. *No new file under `display-price/`* — confirmed: `git status --porcelain -- overrides/app/components/display-price/` errors "no such directory," and `git status --porcelain` overall shows exactly 4 modified, 0 new files.

## Checks run

- `npx tsc --noEmit` — clean, no output.
- `npm run test` — **92 test files passed, 1305 tests passed** (0 failed), including `theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts` (6/6) and `product-item/product-item.css.test.ts` (4/4, unaffected since that file wasn't touched).
- `npm run audit:tokens` — 7 pre-existing unacknowledged violations reported, **none in any file I touched**; my new code (`textStyle`/`var(--zimm-*)` only) added zero new findings.
- `npx eslint` on the 4 changed files — 1 pre-existing prettier error (`item-variant/index.test.tsx:265`, in a test I never touched — confirmed via `git diff`/`git show HEAD` that this exact formatting predates my edit) plus 3 pre-existing warnings, all outside my diff. The one error genuinely in my own new code (`product-item/index.tsx:280`) I fixed and re-verified clean.

## My own unverified gaps

- No live visual check in a running Storybook/dev server — verified via Vitest/tsc only (instructions say not to run `npm start`).
- Didn't run Playwright/CodeRabbit — not part of this step's named scope, and B3 has no P0 spec at this stage.
- Whether the eventual `cartItemMapper` (step 3.4, not yet built) will actually produce a `discountLabel` string compatible with this prop is that step's problem, not verified here.

## What Marcel is missing

Separate from the was/now finding above: `npm run audit:tokens` currently reports 7 live, unacknowledged raw-value violations sitting in the repo right now, with no CI gate catching them (per `css.md`'s own note, it's not wired in yet). Two of the seven are inside the exact cart-item family this whole build lives in (`item-image.tsx:86/104`, `item-price.tsx:61`) — pre-existing, not mine, not blocking, but worth knowing they're there before anyone assumes "the cart override is audit-clean" just because this step's own diff is.
